children: Palantir Technologies named Armada as its inaugural modular data center partner to meet demand for sovereign artificial-intelligence systems.
Palantir said Thursday that Armada, whose products include the Galleon line of modular data centers, would provide the infrastructure underlining its sovereign AI operating system.

"Our ontology gives institutions control over their data, their models, and the inputs they use to fine-tune models," Palantir Chief Executive Alex Karp said. "Armada gives them control over the infrastructure those models operate from, manufactured in the United States and allied nations and delivered in months."
